chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 366 – Ji Ning Defeats a Void Fiendgod & Selects the Legendary Plowshares Sword Array
chapter_meta_description: After thirty years, Ji Ning conquers the eighth floor of the War God Hall. He selects the legendary Plowshares sword formation and prepares for his next great challenge.
og_description: War God Hall conquered! Ji Ning defeats a Void-level Fiendgod and chooses the powerful Plowshares sword array.
twitter_description: Ji Ning clears the War God Hall’s eighth floor, picks a tactical sword array, and sets his sights on the ninth-level golem.

lore_anchors.definition: A tiered combat trial within the aquatic palace, granting Immortal-ranked treasures to those who conquer its floors.
The sixth major realm for Fiendgod Body Refiners, roughly equivalent to the Primal Daoist realm for Ki Refiners.
A set of nine top-grade Immortal flying swords designed to synergize with the Plowshares Sword Technique, a legendary art of the Three Realms.
A high-grade Immortal-ranked treasure that traps or captures enemies within its own spatial dimension.
A classical Xianxia divine ability that allows a cultivator to manifest extra limbs for exponentially increased combat efficacy.
One of the top ten divine abilities of the Three Realms, tempering the user's hands into ultimate weapons capable of crushing stars.
The creator of the Plowshares sword art, a major power of the Three Realms who comprehended a Grand Dao.
The central repository of Dao techniques within the Tristar Crescent Abode on Mount Innerheart.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the War God Hall only give two chances per realm?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A classic Xianxia mechanic to make challenge attempts a limited, valuable resource. It forces the cultivator to be cautious and strategic, as every lost attempt represents a permanently lost top-tier treasure.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What makes the Plowshares swords special?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are a complete set of nine top-grade Immortal flying swords designed to work in perfect harmony with the Plowshares Sword Technique, creating a synergy that makes the set as powerful as an individual near-Pure Yang sword.

It is the Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of the Primal Daoist realm. Defeating one with his current cultivation base showcases Ji Ning's incredible combat talent, as he was fighting a full major realm above his own.
